['Avacon AG '].company_description: Avacon AG is a German energy company that is involved in the development of electrolysis output, green energy capacity, onshore wind and solar projects in Lower Saxony. It is also known for using monitoring and control equipment SIPP and has several active competitors in the energy sector.

['BASF Polyurethanes GmbH '].company_description: BASF Polyurethanes GmbH is the leading supplier of polyurethane basic products, systems, and specialties. The company operates in the chemistry industry and offers a product portfolio that includes polyurethanes for smart agriculture, high-performance polymers, polyoxymethylene (POM), and thermoplastic polyurethane.
